answer: A twelfth lever weights every vouch by the voucher's own audited accuracy, not their number. A new identity's standing is the sum of endorsements, each scaled by how often that endorser's verdicts survived audit — so a ring of fresh Sybils vouching for each other sums to near zero, none having a record yet. Trust shines only through a lantern already proven clear; untested umber voices cast none. To forge influence an attacker must first build real audited accuracy on every key — quartz-hard history no farm fakes in bulk — the honest work the network wants.
